title: Adaptive Quantum Autoencoders for Violence Detection in Surveillance Videos
summary: Published in the 2025 Korea Information and Communications Society Conference Proceedings.
details: Co-authored with A. Mobusher, A. U. Haque, and Hyundong Shin. The paper appears on pages 436-437 of the KICS conference proceedings.

title: Adaptive Quantum Circuit Pruning with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Conference paper presented in the proceedings of the Korea Information and Communications Society Conference.
details: Co-authored with M. M. U. Gondel and Hyundong Shin, this work develops a reinforcement learning approach for adaptive variational quantum-circuit pruning.

title: Joined CQILAB as a Graduate Research Assistant
summary: Began graduate research at Kyung Hee University in quantum information science, AI, and intelligent communication systems.
details: Joined the Communications and Quantum Information Laboratory in the Department of Electronics and Information Convergence Engineering under Prof. Hyundong Shin.

title: Completed Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
summary: Graduated from the National University of Sciences and Technology in Pakistan.
details: Completed a final-year project on violence detection using deep learning and ResNet-50.
